en.caption: Sovereign Types
rows: {@b Village Elder}. The wizened leader of a community offers both civic and moral leadership.
{@b Young Noble}. An ambitious noble eagerly seeks to reform society to align with a personal vision.
{@b Shipwrecked Governor}. A desperate leader struggles to keep people alive in a wilderness they're not prepared to endure.
{@b Ruler Returned}. A tribe's revered leader has returned from the dead and seeks to resurrect their past glories.
{@b Hidden Power}. A mysterious figure manipulates the nation's puppet leader and guides the government's true agenda.
{@b True Regent}. The rightful heir to the throne struggles to reclaim power from a perfect impostor.

en.caption: Magic Mushroom Effects
rows: The creature's skin turns an unusual color. Roll a {@dice d4}: 1, purple with yellow splotches; 2, bright orange with tiger stripes; 3, tree-frog green with red squiggles; 4, hot pink with yellow spots. This change is permanent unless removed by a {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic.
The creature gains the enlarge or reduce effect ({@chance 50} chance of either) of the {@spell enlarge/reduce} spell for 1 hour.

Vocally, the creature can only cluck and croon like a chicken. The creature can also understand and speak to chickens. This curse lasts for 1 hour unless ended by a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic.
The creature can understand and speak all languages for {@dice 1d4} days.
The creature gains the benefits of the {@spell telepathy} spell for the next 24 hours.
The creature gains the benefits of the {@spell speak with plants} spell for 8 hours.
The creature immediately casts the {@spell time stop} spell, requiring no components. Constitution is the spellcasting ability for this spell.
The creature immediately casts the {@spell detect thoughts} spell, requiring no components. Constitution is the spellcasting ability for this spell.
Magical mists pour out of the creature's eyes and ears, acting as a {@spell fog cloud} spell for 1 hour that is centered on the creature and moves with it.
en.name: Magic Mushroom Effects

en.caption: Aristocrat Quests
rows: {@b Noble Union}. You work within multiple noble factions to unite rival families.
{@b Business Breakthrough}. You track down and obtain a wonder your patron believes is the key to their financial fortunes.
{@b Sabotage Rival}. You break into the business or estate of an enemy noble family and undermine their political or professional ventures.
{@b Lost Lineage}. You seek evidence of a lost branch of a noble family or proof that individuals don't possess a noble pedigree.
{@b Origin of Nobility}. You reveal the secret reason why certain individuals were elevated to noble status and how they will soon fulfill their purpose.
{@b The New Nobility}. You recreate the remarkable event that granted today's noble families their special standing, enabling the rise of new nobles.

en.caption: Primal Fruit Effects
rows: The creature regains {@dice 3d8 + 4} hit points, and its skin sheds {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} in a 5-foot radius and {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} for an additional 5 feet for 1 hour

The creature feels a surge of might. For 1 hour, the creature has advantage on attack rolls using Strength, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws. When the effect ends, the creature gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}.

Waves of vitality crash over the creature. The creature's hit point maximum increases by {@dice 2d10}, and it gains the same number of hit points. The increase lasts until the creature finishes a long rest, at which time the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be cursed with a random form of {@variantrule Player Characters as Lycanthropes|MM|lycanthropy} (see "Lycanthropes" in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}).
The creature's skin prickles faintly. For 1 hour, it gains resistance to one damage type (chosen by the DM).

Euphoric visions of {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} swim through the creature's mind. The creature gains the benefits of the {@spell death ward} spell for 8 hours and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the duration.
A faint humming drones in the background of everything the creature hears for 1 hour, during which the creature has advantage on saving throws against spells.

The creature doesn't require food, drink, or sleep for {@dice 1d4} days. For the duration, the creature can't be put to sleep by magic, and its dreams intrude upon its waking thoughts, imposing disadvantage on its Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

Whispers intrude on the creature's mind for 24 hours. For the duration, the creature can telepathically communicate with any creature it can see within 120 feet of it. If the other creature understands at least one language, it can respond telepathically.
en.name: Primal Fruit Effects

en.caption: Academy Contact
rows: {@b Harried Functionary}. A disinterested secretary conveys written correspondence to you from an exceptionally busy or aloof senior faculty member.
{@b Celebrated Instructor}. Despite their throngs of ambitious assistants, a celebrity researcher considers you their star pupil.
{@b Wizened Fixture}. A fantastically old, believed-to-be-deceased librarian gives you assignments from the circulation desk they never leave.
